visualCharacteristics.purpose: filter bar for a listing: category dropdown, optional keyword input and a GO button

contentPattern.structure: key/value rows: Select Name, Select Placeholder, Select Options (list), Keyword Name, Keyword Placeholder, Button, Action. Submitting navigates to Action with the values as query parameters

reuseGuidance: Use above listings filtered by category / status (map catalogue, bid notices). For a keyword-only box use search-keyword.
